research_question: Can a memory frame with poor overall mask quality still contribute useful spatial tokens to some current queries, and can continuous token-level affinity improve frozen-SAM2 video segmentation over native dense attention and a matched frame-broadcast control?
hypothesis: Memory usefulness is query- and token-dependent, not a single quality value for an entire frame. Some spatial tokens from a low-quality stored frame may still match current query features and help segmentation.

literature_basis.primary: XMem (ECCV 2022) uses anisotropic L2 memory similarity with a per-memory-element shrinkage s_i and per-query, per-channel selection e_jc. A low-confidence key can still contribute strongly when a query matches it. Adapt the published KeyProjection heads and exact similarity equation; do not use XMem memory stores, prototype selection, or top-k.
inspected_files: model/memory_util.py: get_similarity and dense get_affinity path
literature_basis.boundary_of_claim: XMem supports the plausibility of element-level confidence and query-conditioned matching in VOS. It does not prove this SAM2 adaptation improves Dice or that a low-quality frame contains beneficial tokens.

method.insertion_point: Add a residual affinity to the spatial K/V logits in each of SAM2's four existing memory cross-attention layers.
method.query_input: The normalized current query feature before SAM2 positional encoding.
method.memory_input: Each stored spatial memory feature before SAM2 spatial/temporal positional encoding; pointer tail is excluded from the adapter.
method.similarity: XMem anisotropic L2: -s_i * sum_c[e_jc * (k_ic-q_jc)^2] / sqrt(C). The learned per-memory-token shrinkage is d_i^2+1; per-query channel selection is sigmoid(e_j). Add alpha_l times this score to the original SAM2 dot-product logits. alpha_l is zero-initialized. Scores are computed densely in query chunks to bound peak temporary memory.
method.preserved: All pretrained SAM2 weights, native Q/K/V projections, RoPE, values, memory encoder, frame schedule, all spatial memory tokens, object pointers, and mask decoder. Only added XMem-style projections and one scalar per layer are trainable.
method.forbidden: No top-k, token deletion, hard mask, confidence threshold, frame-quality gate, good/bad frame choice, or ground truth at inference. Pointer logits receive zero added affinity. No explicit foreground/background/boundary label is required.
method.claim_scope: The adapter changes query-to-token compatibility. It does not establish semantic purity of a memory vector or identify an anatomical region.

arms.native: Unmodified pretrained SAM2 dense memory attention.
arms.token_affinity: XMem-style per-token shrinkage plus per-query channel selection in all four memory cross-attention layers.
arms.frame_broadcast_control: Same affinity heads and parameter count, but average the complete query-to-token anisotropic-L2 score over the spatial tokens of each source frame and broadcast that query/frame mean uniformly to all spatial keys in the frame. This preserves learned frame-level weighting while removing within-frame token score variation. It is not a hard frame selector.

before_real_data: Eight targeted unit checks pass: exact four-layer zero-strength identity; XMem equation matches direct anisotropic-L2 calculation; token treatment can vary within a frame; all spatial keys receive a finite dense score; pointer-tail score is zero; finite adapter-only gradients; frozen SAM2 weights; and frame-broadcast control is constant within each frame while remaining continuous and dense.
With the pinned real SAM2 checkpoint, load every original attention tensor bit-identically and verify all four memory layers are adapted.
On seq2 and seq3, require zero-strength full-model outputs and stored memory hashes to match native; require unchanged frame IDs, all four layers, RoPE coordinates, and pointer tensors/counts.

At nonzero strength, require finite adapter-only gradients, unchanged memory bank and pointers, identical number/order of keys, and finite scores. Verify no source frame is skipped and no token is removed.
Run a save/resume equivalence check for adapter, optimizer, and RNG state before efficacy training.
engineering_gate.current_verification: Focused synthetic checks pass for within-frame score variation, attention integration, and equation parity. A real-checkpoint gate is implemented at scripts/verify_xmem_token_affinity.py but has not been run. The gate must reject deviations from the frozen sequences, sampled frames, file hashes, clip length, seed, CPU device, and Python/PyTorch versions.
engineering_gate.scope_limitations: The seq2/seq3 PolypGen engineering gate is single-object. It does not establish persistent multi-object ID handling; DAVIS/LVOS evaluation requires a separate real multi-object parity and identity gate.

analysis_before_training.purpose: Directly test the user's within-frame premise, which earlier Run171/173 results did not isolate.
analysis_before_training.design: On frozen native trajectories, perturb one stored source frame at a time while holding every other source frame, query, pointer, and position fixed. Use pre-specified equal-size spatial blocks from that frame and a matched random-block control; record target Dice changes. Independently report the source frame's continuous GT Dice only for post-hoc stratification, never for selection. Analyze within-frame spread of group utility and its association with continuous source-frame quality at the sequence level.
analysis_before_training.interpretation: Mixed helpful and harmful block effects within a low-quality source frame would support local utility heterogeneity at group resolution, not individual-token causality, semantic purity, or deployment benefit. This diagnostic is not the method's efficacy result.
analysis_before_training.status: Implemented as the separate fixed-history within-frame token-utility diagnostic; its full-cohort run is in progress under outputs/experiment/within_frame_token_utility_v1/scientific_run_20261108. Complete and review this diagnostic before any XMem gate or efficacy run.

efficacy.data: PolypGen only after Run174 is complete and the source-frame diagnostic and real-checkpoint engineering gate pass. Existing PolypGen sequences have informed earlier work; label the result exploratory, not independent confirmation.
efficacy.split: Reuse the fixed project train/validation/test manifest roles. Do not move sequences, tune seeds, or inspect the pilot-test results for method changes.
efficacy.training: Identical clips, seed, optimizer, schedule, validation epochs, and autoregressive predicted-mask writes for token-affinity and frame-broadcast control. Original SAM2 weights are frozen. Ground truth is used only as training loss after prompt and as evaluation labels.
efficacy.primary: Equal-sequence present-frame Dice; report paired changes against both native SAM2 and frame-broadcast control.
secondary: Attention and adapter runtime, peak memory, and key/token counts
efficacy.practical_success_rule: The frozen token-affinity checkpoint must improve equal-sequence present Dice by at least 0.01 over native SAM2 and the frame-broadcast control, with paired sequence-bootstrap 95% lower bounds above zero for both contrasts, and no material rise in false alarms or missed returns. If this fails, report the negative/inconclusive result and stop this candidate; do not adjust the score or architecture on test sequences.
efficacy.external_confirmation: Required before any publishable generalization claim. PolypGen and the already-inspected DAVIS validation set cannot serve as untouched confirmation.

outputs: After authorization by the protocol's prerequisites, store all experiment outputs and receipts under mounted Drive outputs/experiment/xmem_token_affinity_polypgen_v1. A Drive-mounted path alone is not proof of cloud synchronization.

implementation.sam2_integration: No vendored SAM2 source edit. The adapter replaces only each existing cross-attention module after verifying pos_enc_at_cross_attn_queries is false; it receives the native call's normalized query q and unpositioned memory value input v, while the original positional key k remains in SAM2 RoPE attention.
implementation.real_training_runner: Not implemented. Do not launch until Run174 is terminal, the real-checkpoint gate passes, and any failure is resolved without bypassing parity or integrity checks.
